post.text: Police just uncovered a YouTube 'view farm' after a sting operation... Phones mounted to the ceiling running nonstop for fake views. https://t.co/kbu4O40HIF
post.author_description: #SpacesHost | Truth Slayer | ↗️ I follow all Subscribers • Let's end the establishment media • ʟɪꜱᴛᴇɴ ᴡɪᴛʜ ᴄᴜʀɪᴏꜱɪᴛʏ. ꜱᴘᴇᴀᴋ ᴡɪᴛʜ ʜᴏɴᴇꜱᴛʏ. ᴀᴄᴛ ᴡɪᴛʜ ɪɴᴛᴇɢʀɪᴛʏ.

description.description: A series of four frames from a video showing an extensive array of smartphones set up in rows on walls and shelving units, commonly referred to as a 'click farm' or 'bot farm'. The first two frames display grids of phones mounted on vertical panels with numerous charging cables. The third frame shows a dimly lit aisle between two racks of glowing smartphones. The final frame features police or security personnel in uniforms examining the facility.

tweetMedia.transcription: Olha isso. Meu Deus do céu, são centenas. Os dados no YouTube, é uma fazenda de visualização. Quem montou isso aqui gastou uma fortuna. A gente precisa chamar o pessoal da inteligência agora. O celular até o teto. Parece uma colmeia. Vai dar um trabalho.
